title: A focused audit found tissue missed in the broad audit
claim: In BR-017, Sol/xhigh missed a 21.04 mL pancreas-to-duodenum tissue reassignment during a broad 13-organ audit, then identified the correct host, included organ and interior point in a fresh pair-focused audit of the same data. Separate whole-absorption and unchanged-label conditions passed. This establishes a supplied-mask auditing capability with a scope-dependent miss on this fixture.
limitations: Each condition has one fresh attempt on one public case; the focused pass does not establish that attention alone caused the difference.
The agent received full CT, masks, proposed organ names and rendering helpers; this is an audit of supplied segmentations, not segmentation from scratch.

The controlled edit and its scoring point do not establish source contour accuracy or clinical diagnostic performance. Earlier calibration experiments remain dependencies for review propagation, not additional replications of BR-017.
